title: Which runtime does M2 build the state machine on?
lead: Both candidates pass all 17 host-contract rows. Outside module rows, VOS fails every gap row the purpose-built store fails, and nine more.
bullets: The store's gaps close in rutent's own code; VOS's close upstream, with one maintainer.
Before production, the store must refuse a damaged acknowledged entry and bound its memory.
The recommended option adds no package and needs no licence ruling.
Choosing VOS needs its AGPL-3.0-or-later licence ruled first, then 246 more licence lines.
rec: the purpose-built store, because its gaps are VOS's too and close in rutent's own code.
options: Purpose-built store for M2; drop VOS for v0 (recommended)
VOS for M2, once its licence is ruled
